notes:
Snapshot: enterprise FS vendor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing chat + internal doc search. Preference: EU residency (primary), BYOK KMS, SAML SSO. InfoSec-led procurement; legal and procurement engaged.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2025-11-10: Intro call (AE Maya). high-level requirements captured.
- 2025-11-24: Architecture workshop with infra (Liam) — they provided sample VPC CIDR and egress constraints.
- 2025-12-08: Demo (hosted) showing chat latency and streaming; product team asked about audit trails.
- 2026-01-12: Sent SIG questionnaire (partial), asked for CAIQ mapping.
- 2026-01-28: Security deep-dive with InfoSec (Priya present). talked through KMS integration and key lifecycle (BYOK + HSM requirement).
- 2026-02-02: Performance POC kickoff; Redwood supplied initial perf targets and runbook.
- 2026-02-14: Follow-up on data residency wrap-up; legal requested detailed shared responsibility matrix.

What they care about / requirements:
- Data residency: EU-only processing and storage for PII and transaction metadata. Must demonstrate network egress controls and region locking.
- KMS: BYOK with external HSM or KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS) integration. Customer must retain key control; Redwood to support key rotation windows and key-export restrictions.
- Audit logging: Full request/response auditing for admin operations; token-level cost traces not required in logs. Logs must be shipped to customer SIEM (Splunk) and retained per their retention policy.
- SIG/CAIQ: Security team requested completed SIG with attachments and CAIQ mapping for SOC2/ISO controls. Current status: ~60% complete, outstanding on crypto/key management and incident response sections.
- Shared responsibility: Customer wants explicit written map showing which controls Redwood will own (runtime patching, model updates, infra) vs customer controls (prompt/content governance, user access, key custody). Legal asked for an appendix to standard MSA.
- Latency/throughput: Target 90th pct latency for chat < 120ms in eu region; POC target throughput ~300 RPS for embeddings farm with quantized models.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; looking to trade quantized models + batching to meet cost targets. Redwood Optimize feature interest.

POC / Eval notes:
- POC scope: 6-week evaluation — security questionnaire completion, KMS integration test (BYOK), audit log ingestion to customer SIEM, performance benchmarks on a representative workload.
- Success metrics: CAIQ/SIG accepted by InfoSec, KMS test passed, SIEM pipeline validated, latency/throughput within 10% of targets.
- Current blockers: procurement wants signed data processing addendum (DPA) with EU residency clause; security team flagged incident reporting SLA mismatch; legal needs clarification on indemnity related to model content.

Quotes / call takeaways: "We need BYOK — no exceptions for production keys" — InfoSec.
"If the SIG/CAIQ isn't complete we can't move to procurement" — Procurement lead.

Next steps (short):
- Finish SIG and CAIQ mapping (ASSIGNED: Liam & Security Eng). due 2026-02-25.
- Produce shared responsibility matrix doc and DPA redline (Legal).
- Schedule vendor risk debrief with InfoSec (target week of 2026-03-01).
- KMS integration runbook handed to their infra team; POC encryption test planned for 2026-02-22.
